title: Rule
description: Front matter schema for AGF-NG rules rule files

id.description: Kebab-case rule identifier. Unique within the rules.

applies_to.description: Which actor types this rule constrains.

evidence.description: Learning ID, codename, or citation that justifies this rule.

upstream_candidate.description: True if this rule is ready to propose back to the upstream framework.

strength.description: Obligation strength. Defaults to MUST if omitted.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Defaults to active if omitted.

provenance.description: Origin and verification status of this rule relative to AGF v2. inherited-v1x-unverified: carried from v1.x with no v2 review; adapted-from-v1x: touched during v2 development but not fully reviewed; verified-agf-v2: explicitly reviewed against AGF v2 operating model; foundry-native: created natively for AGF v2.
